notes: RTS ROAMEO AP-1800 is a DECT wireless access point for the ROAMEO wireless intercom system (Bosch/RTS), not a traditional AV signal-routing box — included here per request. Source is the official Bosch Security Systems / RTS Technical Data Sheet (Form F.01U.306.748 Rev 03, Aug 2017), mirrored at the concept-sonore.com URL above and matching the manufacturer product page at products.rtsintercoms.com/na/en/ap-1800. Two Reverse-Polarity-SMA-Female (R-SMA-F) detachable antenna connectors are also present on the unit (for the included ANT-1800 antennas) but were omitted from the ports list because no RF-antenna connector type exists in the given enum. Ethernet is specified only as "Standard 100Base-T or GigE Ethernet" (auto-capable, no fixed per-port speed given), so eth-1g was used as the (max-supported) grade. Optical/SFP port's link-rate class isn't stated in the datasheet, so no grade was set. Not rack-mountable — small surface/pole-mount enclosure (5.17"H x 7.67"W x 1.52"D). An EU variant (AP-1800 EU) exists with a different DECT frequency band (1880-1900 MHz vs 1920-1930 MHz NA) but identical physical I/O.

ports.name: Ethernet 1
ports.note: One of 2 daisy-chainable RJ-45 jacks (up to 7 APs/hops); auto-selects 100Base-T or GigE per datasheet, protocol OMNEO.

ports.name: Ethernet 2
ports.note: Second RJ-45 jack, same spec as Ethernet 1, used for daisy-chaining APs.

ports.name: Optical
ports.note: Accepts SFP modules (Single Mode F.01U.278.502 or Multi Mode F.01U.278.503); optional fiber alternative to Ethernet. Data rate/grade not stated in datasheet.

ports.name: Power
ports.note: 12VDC @ 1.5A, positive center, 5.5mm x 2.5mm x 13.8mm locking barrel jack; fed by external wall-wart PSU (100-240VAC input).
